replacement:
(deftype StringBufferWriter [sb]
  IWriter
  (-write [_ s] (.append sb s))
  (-flush [_] nil)
  ;; java.io.Writer's methods, which print-method methods call (#302).
  Object
  (write [_ s] (.append sb s) nil)
  (append [this s] (.append sb s) this)
  (flush [_] nil))
rationale: Retain the entire pinned writer type and both IWriter methods. Add java.io.Writer's write, append and flush as Object methods, so print-method and print-dup methods write as Clojure's do, with (.write w s) (#302). They take strings; Suss's characters are strings. Writer's write of an int code point or a char array is not supported.
